description:
Get food logged in Garmin Connect (or a linked app such as MyFitnessPal) per day: calories, carbs, protein and fat against the day's goals, and meals; plus hydration (ml) from the daily summary.

Food logs are fetched from Garmin on demand and cached. Defaults to the last 7 days, at most 31 per call.

response_format.description: 'markdown' for readable text (default), 'json' for complete structured data

name: garmin_get_nutrition
title: Nutrition and hydration
